obligations.source_text: Create an adult harem-romance ensemble scene whose visible one-center and three-or-more-partner topology can be strictly tested in a complex photographic setting.

bindings.multi_interest_center_phrase: one clearly adult person is the common target and compositional center of every bid, fully visible where the three separate approach paths converge
bindings.multi_interest_partner_count_phrase: at least three separate clearly adult potential partners remain individually readable through distinct bodies, faces, hands, and approach paths
bindings.multi_interest_distinct_bid_phrase: each potential partner directs a different concrete invitation help offer or proposal to the same center: umbrella, hot drink with scarf, or replacement ticket with map
bindings.multi_interest_center_response_phrase: the central adult visibly pauses sequences or manages the simultaneous incoming bids by raising one hand and controlling the overlapping handoffs
bindings.multi_interest_cross_awareness_phrase: cross-glances paused hands or spatial adjustments show that the partners notice the overlapping bids and actively make room around one another
